entity: Regional disparity in enforcement follow-up on inspected RCRA hazardous-waste sites
what_we_add: The named regions and the split: 78% no-action in Regions 6 and 9 vs 33% in Regions 7 and 8
why: The EPA OIG's April 2026 report states the same finding in words: wide variability in RCRA enforcement by state, region and inspecting agency, with most violations drawing no formal action. Our region-by-region percentages appear in no source.
